correctness.rationale: Every nonempty cross-bifix-free binary code has uniform leading bit and opposite trailing bit, allowing orientation 0..1. Eligible unbordered words constitute vertices of an exact compatibility graph, with edges iff all cross-overlaps and deletion descendants are disjoint. Recursion on increasing vertex indices with intersection of later-neighbor masks enumerates every clique exactly once; this is an exhaustive finite certificate, not extrapolation. An independently written enumeration regenerated vertex counts (1,2,3,6,10,20,37,74,142), maxima (1,1,1,1,2,2,4,6,9), and complete n=10 clique census (1,142,4566,51196,216875,347859,200412,37440,1800,6); six oriented size-nine optima, twelve labeled via complement, three four-element reversal/complement orbits. No n>10 conclusion is claimed.

A certified exact n<=10 capacity profile, complete n=10 optimizer list, and symmetry orbit count are a meaningful finite cutoff; no asymptotic or end-to-end streaming promise is inferred.
